explanation: The theorem is a Poisson-summation tail estimate for factorizable test functions on GL2 over the adeles of a number field. It is stated with unipotentGL2, IsFactorizableTestFn and adelicBox, and it uses an adelic Haar measure and a Schwartz-Bruhat space. I grepped Mathlib for unipotentGL2, IsFactorizableTestFn and adelicBox and found no matches. Mathlib also has no adelic Poisson summation with a decay bound of this kind. So I found no duplicate or one-step special case.
